project_context.name: FATEC Academic Time-Sheet Automation
project_context.description: A hybrid fullstack dashboard and ERP system for automating academic timesheets. Key operations include managing professors, courses, disciplines, schedule creation (conflict resolution), and PDF generation of timesheets.
project_context.emotional_tone: Authority, Clarity, Truth (Swiss & High-Contrast Archetype) - Government/Educational grade, trustworthy, functional.

typography.strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' & 'Swiss Brutalist' fusion. Clear, institutional, and legible for data density.

colors.strategy: FATEC / Centro Paula Souza Official Identity. Monochrome structural base with high-contrast institutional red for actions.

usage.background: bg-[#F3F4F6] (Light gray to make white cards pop)

anti_patterns: NO teal green or teal blue (#1B93A4)
NO pure #000000, use #0A0A0A (Tinted Black) or #273336 (Slate Gray)

surface_strategies.dashboard_cards: Flat Background, 1px crisp border (border-[#BFBFBF]/40), zero shadow by default. Hover adds subtle shadow (shadow-sm) and slightly darkens border.
surface_strategies.header_nav: Solid white background (bg-white) with a hard 1px bottom border (border-[#BFBFBF]/40) for structure. NO transparent headers.
surface_strategies.modals_dialogs: Flat white background, sharp corners (rounded-none or max rounded-sm), heavy backdrop (bg-[#273336]/80 backdrop-blur-sm).

layouts.spacing_system: Dense layout for data correlation. Use p-4 to p-6 for cards. p-8 for main page sections.
layouts.dashboard_grid: Mode B: High Density Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 or grid-cols-12 for fine-grained control. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6).
layouts.alignment: Left-align text and data. Right-align numerical values in tables.

component_guidelines.buttons: Sharp edges or minimal radius (rounded-sm). High contrast. Primary uses FATEC Red (#FF161F). Avoid pill shapes; stick to institutional rectangle.
component_guidelines.data_tables: Sticky leftmost column for identifiers. Sortable headers. Row hover state (bg-[#F3F4F6]). Use 1px bottom border per row (border-[#BFBFBF]/30). NO vertical dividers.
component_guidelines.forms_inputs: Shadcn UI standard customized: Sharp corners (rounded-sm), focus state must have high contrast (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#FF161F] focus:border-transparent).
component_guidelines.pdf_generation: Ensure UI has a clear, isolated state/button for 'Gerar PDF', using an icon (e.g., Phosphor Icons FilePdf) and prominent placement.

motion.strategy: Minimalist. Institutional apps should feel snappy and reliable.
motion.interactions: Hover states on rows and buttons (-translate-y-[1px] on cards, subtle color shifts).
motion.loading: Skeleton screens (animate-pulse in light gray) instead of spinners to maintain structural layout.

accessibility.contrast: Strict APCA/WCAG AA adherence. White text on FATEC Red (#FF161F) passes requirements.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='generate-pdf-btn').
accessibility.focus: Visible focus rings on all inputs/buttons (ring-2 ring-[#FF161F] ring-offset-2 ring-offset-white).

media.icons_library: @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone or regular weight for institutional clarity).

login_background.description: Modern educational architecture. Use as half-screen or full-screen background for the Google Login page, with a dark or FATEC Red overlay.

abstract_accent.description: Abstract glossy red material. Use sparingly as a banner background in the ADM Master dashboard header, wrapped in an overflow-hidden container with a heavy black/slate overlay (bg-[#273336]/80) to maintain text contrast.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Use .js and .jsx extensions for all React components. Do NOT use .tsx.
Implement Google Login UI and structural routing first (ADM Master, Operador, Coordenador).
Utilize Shadcn UI components but strip Vercel-like rounded styles. Apply strict FATEC Red (#FF161F) and Slate Gray (#273336) palette.
Build the automated schedule generation UI to visually show conflict resolutions (use distinct badge colors for status: Red=Conflict, Green=Resolved, Gray=Pending).
Install required libraries: `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react chivo @fontsource/chivo @fontsource/ibm-plex-sans sonner`
For the Data Table, create a reusable component with sticky headers, checkbox selection, and action menus (edit/delete) following the 'Admin Dashboard Patterns' research.
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or modals. Use solid `bg-white` with `shadow-md` and `border border-[#BFBFBF]/40`.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) only where appropriate (not for data-heavy sections).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles (sharp/rectangular for institutional) with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
